parameters.query:
WITH food AS (
  SELECT id, brand FROM reviews
  WHERE analyzed AND service = 'food' AND review_date >= now() - interval '7 days'
),
totals AS (SELECT brand, count(*) AS n FROM food GROUP BY brand),
mentions AS (
  SELECT ri.label, f.brand, count(DISTINCT ri.review_id) AS c
  FROM review_issues ri JOIN food f ON f.id = ri.review_id
  GROUP BY ri.label, f.brand
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT m.label,
    round(max(1000.0 * m.c / t.n) FILTER (WHERE m.brand = 'swiggy'), 0) AS swiggy_per_1k,
    round(max(1000.0 * m.c / t.n) FILTER (WHERE m.brand = 'zomato'), 0) AS zomato_per_1k,
    sum(m.c) AS total_mentions
  FROM mentions m JOIN totals t USING (brand)
  GROUP BY m.label
)
SELECT label, swiggy_per_1k, zomato_per_1k, total_mentions,
  round(swiggy_per_1k / NULLIF(zomato_per_1k, 0), 2) AS gap,
  CASE
    WHEN zomato_per_1k IS NULL THEN 'Swiggy only'
    WHEN swiggy_per_1k IS NULL THEN 'Zomato only'
    WHEN swiggy_per_1k / zomato_per_1k > 1.5  THEN 'Swiggy worse'
    WHEN swiggy_per_1k / zomato_per_1k < 0.67 THEN 'Swiggy better'
    ELSE 'Both struggling'
  END AS verdict,
  (SELECT n FROM totals WHERE brand = 'swiggy') AS swiggy_n,
  (SELECT n FROM totals WHERE brand = 'zomato') AS zomato_n
FROM pivot
WHERE total_mentions >= 3
ORDER BY total_mentions DESC
LIMIT 12;
